scope: Standalone CreateNewApplication; source V1 file never saved. Native real rays: one chief plus 512 equal-power Gaussian pupil samples and 32 boundary rays per state. Every ray compared to the independent model at the fixed global work plane. D4sigma here measures geometric ray spread, not a diffractive beam diameter. STRH is an ideal coherent native field diagnostic and does not model measured M2 or POP. Selected cases are reported by their actual targets; nearest available calibration states may differ from requested radii/AOI. This is not a full circular scan or optical manufacturing acceptance, nor a V1/V2 same-case spot quality verdict.
